//: M14-1..M14-4. Separate outDir per suite — see tests/tsconfig.registry.json for why. The four new score modules are I/O-free: `lib/score-inputs.ts` injects its six database verbs as an interface and takes its rows as arguments, and `lib/score-engine.ts`, `lib/score-continuity.ts` and `lib/score-recovery.ts` take an already-built `LedgerScoreInputs` and an `asOfMs` and read no clock at all. There is no Supabase client, no next/*, no localStorage and no `user_data.blob` anywhere in the four. That is what lets V.6.1, V.6.2, V.6.5 and V.6.6 be proved with no live project in reach (U.3).
